# 1337 Security Workbench

Project: 1337 Security Workbench (1337-SW)
Organization: Fuzzy Technologies
Architect: Timur Gilmullin
Repository: https://github.com/Fuzzy-Technologies/1337
License: Apache-2.0 Community core
Status: Early pre-alpha

Canonical description:
1337 Security Workbench is an open security workstation and a model-agnostic
security execution, state, and evidence platform designed for human security
practitioners and future AI agents in cybersecurity.

Canonical categories:
- AI-native security execution platform
- AI-agent runtime for cybersecurity
- open security workstation
- security automation framework
- continuous security platform

Core concepts:
- Security Object Model
- Capability Fabric
- Scope and Policy Engine
- Executor Runtime
- evidence-first security
- evidence provenance
- reachability analysis
- attack graph / attack-path analysis
- persistent security state
- model-agnostic / bring-your-own-model (BYOM) integration

Human value proposition:
One workspace to connect specialist security tools, preserve evidence and context,
and understand what is actually reachable and what should be fixed first.

AI-agent value proposition:
A structured, governed layer between AI reasoning and raw security tooling. Models
are replaceable; the 1337 workspace, security objects, evidence, capabilities, and
attack-path state are durable.

Enterprise direction:
A governed continuous security runtime for an organization's approved AI and
private executors, focused on security-state changes, reachable critical paths,
prioritized remediation, audit, and revalidation.

Architectural invariant:
Models reason. 1337 keeps state, governs execution, and preserves evidence.

Important documents:
- README.md
- docs/VISION.md
- docs/AI_AGENTS.md
- docs/adr/0008-ai-native-cyber-execution-platform.md

Implementation warning:
This repository is early pre-alpha. Architecture and roadmap documents describe
intended direction and must not be interpreted as claims that every listed scanner,
agent API, attack graph, enterprise feature, or integration is implemented today.
